entries.title: Rusting Iron Rod in Acidic Solution
entries.description: A horizontal iron cylinder partially submerged in a transparent liquid bath where red-brown rust patches grow, dissolve, and flake off as acid particles randomly collide with and attach to the metal surface, with a side meter showing corrosion rate over time.

entries.description: Two different metal blocks (e.g., zinc and copper) connected by a wire and immersed in a clear electrolyte, where color-coded ions detach from one metal and drift toward the other, forming deposits while the anode slowly shrinks and the cathode slightly grows, with glowing arrows indicating electron flow.
